requirements.label: lower-division
requirements.title: Three 100- and/or 200-level ARH courses
requirements.sourceText: Three 100- and/or 200-level ARH courses selected from the following (9 credits): ARH 106 - Art & Science 3 credits; ARH 107 - Art and Medicine 3 credits; ARH 201 - Arts of Africa 3 credits; ARH 202 - Arts of the Ancient World 3 credits; ARH 203 - Arts of Asia 3 credits; ARH 204 - Arts of Europe and the Americas 3 credits; ARH 205 - Introduction to Architecture & Design 3 credits; ARH 206 - Modern Art 3 credits; ARH 207 - Digital Media: History/Theory 3 credits; ARH 208 - History of Photography 3 credits; ARH 209 - Arts of the United States 3 credits; ARH 210 - The Art and Technology of Film 3 credits

requirements.label: upper-division
requirements.title: Four 300-level and/or 400-level ARH courses
requirements.sourceText: Four 300-level and/or 400-level ARH courses selected from the following (12 credits): ARH 300 - Greek Art and Architecture 3 credits; ARH 301 - Roman Art and Architecture 3 credits; ARH 302 - Ancient Egyptian Art 3 credits; ARH 306 - Italian Renaissance Art 3 credits; ARH 308 - Writing About Art 3 credits; ARH 315 - Art of Spain and Colonial Latin America 3 credits; ARH 316 - Italian Baroque Art 3 credits; ARH 317 - Islamic Art 3 credits; ARH 321 - Women Artists, 1400-1750 3 credits; ARH 322 - American Art Since 1947 3 credits; ARH 323 - History and Methods of Art History 3 credits; ARH 325 - Ancient Middle Eastern Art 3 credits; ARH 326 - Arts of Ancient Mesoamerica 3 credits; ARH 328 - Exhibiting Africa 3 credits; ARH 329 - Arts of the African Diaspora 3 credits; ARH 330 - Public Art and Urban Design in New York City 3 credits; ARH 333 - Arts for the Public 3 credits; ARH 334 - Performance Art I: The European Avant-Garde 3 credits; ARH 336 - The Computer and the Arts 3 credits; ARH 339 - The Art and Science of Astronomy 3 credits; ARH 344 - Performance Art II: World War II to the Present 3 credits; ARH 346 - Art and Politics in the Age of Revolution 3 credits; ARH 347 - Avant-Garde Art: Realism, Impressionism, Post-Impressionism 3 credits; ARH 348 - Contemporary Art 3 credits; ARH 350 - Museum Studies 3 credits; ARH 355 - Modern and Contemporary Korean Art 3 credits; ARH 390 - Topics in European Art 3 credits; ARH 391 - Topics in Global Art 3 credits; ARH 392 - Topics in Modern Art 3 credits; ARH 393 - Topics in Middle Eastern Art 3 credits; ARH 394 - Topics in Asian Art 3 credits; ARH 395 - Topics in Visual Culture 3 credits; ARH 396 - Topics in American Art 3 credits; ARH 397 - Topics in Photography 3 credits; ARH 398 - Topics in Film and Video Art 3 credits; ARH 400 - Seminar in Art History and Criticism 3 credits

requirements.label: credits
requirements.title: Minor credit totals

rule.text: Completion of the minor requires 21 credits in art history, of which at least twelve credits must be in upper-division courses.
rule.reason: Program-wide credit minimums are not expressible with the available rule types

requirements.sourceText: Completion of the minor requires 21 credits in art history, of which at least twelve credits must be in upper-division courses.

policies.sourceText: All courses offered for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.
All courses offered for the minor must be passed with a letter grade of C or higher.
Art History transfer students must take at least 6 upper division ARH credits for the minor at Stony Brook.

notes.text: The residency requirement of at least 6 upper-division ARH credits at Stony Brook applies to transfer students only. Transfer status cannot be checked from a transcript; confirm it with the department.
